meta.title: UAP example gallery: selected held-out images across perturbation budgets
meta.model_config: original interestingness task, blank prompt; each image is shown as the model received it, clean and with the UAP of each budget added

feature_labels.excited_vs_angry: Excitement vs anger direction at language_29

units.epsilon: L_inf bound in processor-normalised pixel units (valid range [-1, 1]); epsilon_fraction_of_pixel_range = epsilon / 2

meta.aggregation: per-image model outputs as saved; ratings from results/attack_eval_projected/interestingness, clean label and text from the study labels; perturbed text from a later run of the same runner, used only where that run reproduced the released rating
caveats: The examples are chosen for the size of their shift. They are not representative: see all_images_shift_at_ranking_epsilon for the whole sample.
For a target where selection_includes_every_larger_shift is false, some unselected images shift more than the selected opposite-direction example.

The budgets are large: epsilon = 1.0 allows a change of half the pixel range and epsilon = 2.0 spans the whole range, so epsilon = 2.0 is not an imperceptible perturbation and should be read as a saturation regime.
Perturbed evaluation text marked 'pending' has not been generated yet.
The clean rating and text come from the study's label collection, not from the UAP evaluation run.
The images are 8-bit renderings of the model input; subtracting the clean image recovers the perturbation wherever it is not clipped.
Source photographs are from Open Images V7 (listed there as CC BY 2.0); per-image attribution is not yet included.

panel_label: Largest observed rating shifts in the dominant direction and the largest opposite shift at ε = 1.00; not representative examples

selection_rule.pool: the 100 held-out evaluation images whose output parsed at every budget
selection_rule.metric: absolute change in numeric rating at epsilon = 1.00; a non-zero change always crosses a rating category on this five-label scale
selection_rule.selection: the 4 highest-ranked shifts in the dominant direction (sign of the mean shift over all valid images) and the 1 highest-ranked shift in the opposite direction
selection_rule.text_criterion: not applied: perturbed evaluation text was not saved by the released run for all images

image_encoding.content: the model-input tensor (image processor output, plus the perturbation, clamped to [-1, 1]) mapped to 8-bit RGB
